steps.label: A label like "return over the next 5 days"

steps.label: A training row just before the test block

steps.label: Train on that row and you train on the test period

eyebrow: Two separate fixes, two separate leaks

steps.label: Train (purged zone)
steps.sub: dropped if this row's label window reaches into test

steps.label: Test block
steps.sub: held out, never trained on, in any fold

steps.label: Embargo buffer
steps.sub: dropped automatically right after test, no label overlap needed

steps.label: Train resumes
steps.sub: far enough past test that serial correlation has decayed

code:
class PurgedKFold(KFold):
    def split(self, X, y=None, groups=None):
        n = len(X)
        embargo = int(n * self.embargo_frac)
        indices = np.arange(n)
        for test_start, test_stop in self._test_ranges(n):
            test_idx = indices[test_start:test_stop]
            before = indices[indices < test_start]
            after = indices[indices >= test_stop]
            # PURGE: label must resolve before test starts
            before = before[self.label_end[before] < test_start]
            # EMBARGO: drop a buffer right after test
            after = after[after >= test_stop + embargo]
            yield np.concatenate([before, after]), test_idx
caption: scikit-learn has no built-in class for this -- KFold and TimeSeriesSplit know nothing about label windows.

subtitle: Applying purging and embargoing to every possible combination of groups, not just one split.
